name: Gianni D'Angelo
source:
D 'Angelo fancies himself an undead detective. With a knack for gathering information and getting into places he's not supposed to be, and a habit of verbally narrating his own actions, he's the spitting image of a neo-noir private eye.

He has a few ties to the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla[/url] structures - chief among them an occasional ally in [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Qadir_al-Asmai]Qadir Al-Asmai[/url] - but most often, he works alone. One reason is that he does not shy away from cases presented to him by the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Anarch]Anarchs[/url], or the much maligned thin-bloods.

Like the detectives that he models himself on, D'Angelo might seem crude or cynical, but he's more empathetic than he lets on.

[Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook[/url]]
